facts.entrepreneurial: Do you run the rental as a business?
facts.entrepreneurialHint: For example with a VAT number, as a company or under the presumption based on the number of flats (art. 1, par. 595, Law 178/2020). Only in this case are the safety requirements of the systems needed (art. 13-ter, par. 7, first sentence).
facts.gasSupply: Does the unit have a gas system or supply (mains, LPG or cylinders)?

facts.combustionWithoutGas: With a combustion appliance (for example a fireplace or a stove) the carbon monoxide risk is not ruled out: the detectors remain required even without gas.

FireExtinguishers.title: Portable fire extinguishers
FireExtinguishers.reference: Always required: compliant with the law, in accessible and visible positions, especially near the entrances and the most dangerous areas (art. 13-ter, par. 7, second sentence).
FireExtinguishers.faq: According to the FAQ of the Ministry of Tourism: extinguishing capacity of at least 13A, charge of at least 6 kg or 6 litres, periodic check under the UNI 9994-1 standard.
FireExtinguishers.dateLabel: Date of the last periodic check

GasDetector.title: Combustible gas detector
GasDetector.reference: Working device, also removable (art. 13-ter, par. 7, second sentence; FAQ of the Ministry of Tourism).

CoDetector.title: Carbon monoxide (CO) detector
CoDetector.reference: Working device, also removable (art. 13-ter, par. 7, second sentence; FAQ of the Ministry of Tourism).

SystemsCompliance.title: Compliant systems
SystemsCompliance.reference: Systems in the unit (electrical, gas, heating, water) compliant with national and regional rules, with a declaration of conformity or of correspondence (Ministerial Decree 37/2008). Only when the rental is run as a business (art. 13-ter, par. 7, first sentence).
SystemsCompliance.dateLabel: Date of the declaration of conformity

BdsrDeclaration.title: Declaration in the BDSR
BdsrDeclaration.reference: You declared the safety requirements in the national database of accommodation (BDSR) with the CIN request or update (art. 13-ter, par. 3).
BdsrDeclaration.dateLabel: Date of the declaration in the BDSR

SmokeDetector.title: Smoke detector
SmokeDetector.reference: Recommended: art. 13-ter does not require it.

EmergencyInstructions.title: Emergency instructions and numbers for guests
EmergencyInstructions.reference: Recommended: art. 13-ter does not require them.

blockers.safety_entrepreneurial_unanswered: State whether you run the rental as a business: the safety requirements of the systems depend on it.

blockers.safety_gas_detector_missing: Combustible gas detector: required, because the unit has gas or combustion appliances (art. 13-ter, par. 7).
blockers.safety_co_detector_missing: Carbon monoxide detector: required, because the unit has gas or combustion appliances (art. 13-ter, par. 7).
blockers.safety_systems_compliance_missing: Compliant systems: required when the rental is run as a business (art. 13-ter, par. 7, first sentence).
blockers.safety_systems_compliance_review: Systems: the old checklist stated a compliance certificate of the gas system. Confirm the answer.
blockers.safety_bdsr_declaration_missing: Confirm that you declared the safety requirements in the BDSR, with the CIN request or update (art. 13-ter, par. 3).
blockers.safety_confirmation_missing: Confirm the safety checklist with the current answers.

warnings.safety_floor_areas_missing: Without the m² of each floor the minimum is based on the floors only. The law requires one extinguisher every 200 m² of floor or fraction, with at least one per floor.
